state: Recorded design; portable copy requires separate build/timing approval, and is not authorization to run.
harness_amendment: #948 exact lifecycle fix plus matching campaign validator; workload/timing source unchanged
server_cpus: 8-10,20-22; inspect only, never change affinity or restart cluster
gate: Shared validation lock; no Bazel clients/actions or testcontainers/reapers; 60 s continuously quiet settle; load1 <=7.5 afterward. Monitor build/container activity throughout. Load is an initial gate, not later sample censoring.

narrow.rotation: Cells rotate left by block b; rotate chronological arms left by (4*b + 2*cell_position) mod 12; reverse in odd blocks.
narrow.fixed_design: Both cells retained: predicted 4-6.5 minutes, below 20-minute cap. Never drop blocks or cells after timing starts.

estimators.process: p50/p99 from sorted measured samples at ceil(q*N)-1, empirical inverse CDF; warmup excluded; never pool processes.
estimators.primary: For each cell and metric, geometric mean of within-block arm/old process-quantile ratios.
estimators.adjacent: For each cell and metric, geometric mean of within-block chronologically later/earlier revision process-quantile ratios.
estimators.absolute_display: Geometric mean of process p50/p99, not a percentile of pooled operations.
estimators.ranges: Retain all block ratios and label block min/max, not CI; no bootstrap or confidence/equivalence claim.
estimators.validity: Require every scheduled process, zero errors, exact raw counts/checks, persistence/lifecycle/identity/GRV validation, stable pins and successful cleanup. Aborted/partial slots have no comparative summary.

study: New narrow get100 w8 source-interval bisect; not an amendment or execution of v1 SLOT2

cell_roles.get100/w8: PRIMARY: p50 adjacent-interval ratios and anchor endpoint
cell_roles.get1000/w8: SECONDARY, EXPLORATORY: p50; not previously tested in local SLOT1
cell_roles.p99: Descriptive diagnostics only, not a primary/secondary endpoint

interpretation: Report every one of the eleven primary adjacent-revision p50 ratios with four block ratios and block min/max (not CI), plus the master/old endpoint. Identify the largest upward point-estimate interval and any intervals upward in all four sampled blocks; these are descriptive source intervals, not significance tests or causal mechanisms. If the +20% endpoint does not recur, say so without suppressing the complete results. Secondary get1000 is exploratory; it cannot redefine the primary or gate reporting.
prerequisite: Separate owner authorization for this new study; v1 global SLOT1 criterion failed, so original SLOT2 remains unrun. Primary-only v1 get100/w8 p50 reproduced at1.2045574711834806.

provenance.reuse: Exact existing 10 interiors plus 2 anchors; no rebuild or main-checkout edits.

estimate.calculation: 60s settle +96*(1.5s nominal or3s conservative)/process +30s cleanup reserve +10s summary/controller allowance
estimate.observed_budget_input: Previous valid get100/w8 eight processes: wall min0.502106/median0.552681/max0.602089s, for budgeting only.
estimate.secondary_retained: 96 total processes; even conservative estimate fits20min. No cell removal or optional block reduction.
